subject: Canary credit approval for feature deferral
messages:
From: Emily Pratt <emily.pratt@acme.health>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot onboarding: delay to multimodel support and request for pilot credit

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from the onboarding team — engineering just pushed the multimodel routing milestone by three weeks. That deferral blocks our scheduled pilot with the canary cohort next week; the pilots were the gating metric for a larger rollout we committed to in the contract.

This is going to materially delay our go-live and increase operational costs on our side while we run a trimmed-down pilot. Given the impact, Acme is asking for a temporary pilot credit to offset the rework and to help us keep the pilot active while Redwood finishes the fix.

Requested: a 1-month hosted-credit equal to expected pilot spend (~$12k) or a 20% rate credit for the trial period — flexible on structure, urgent on timing.

I attached a quick impact summary. Happy to jump on a short call.

Thanks,
Emily Pratt
Program Manager, Platform Onboarding
Acme Health

Attachments: pilot-impact-summary.xlsx

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Emily Pratt <emily.pratt@acme.health>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: delay to multimodel support and request for pilot credit

Emily — thanks for the clear summary and the spreadsheet. I’m looping in Grace (product) and Karthik (BD) to get ETA and proposed commercial remediation.

Short plan proposal from sales: we offer a timeboxed "canary credit" to keep the pilot moving — 1 month of hosted credits (~$12k) OR a 20% discount on pilot runs, whichever is more administratively straightforward. This would be a one-off, non-recurring concession tied to the delayed multimodel feature.

Grace — can you confirm the ETA for the multimodel routing fix and whether the pilot can use the single-model fallback safely for 2–3 weeks? If not, please advise the minimum dev/infra work required to unblock a limited canary.

Karthik / Laura — we’ll need exec signoff and a billing note (deal id, invoice credit) if product confirms the workaround. I attached the SOW and impact doc so RevOps has context. Can we move fast on this? Emily needs an answer by EOD tomorrow to keep the customer cadence.

Thanks — J

Attachments: pilot-sow.pdf; pilot-impact-summary.xlsx

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, emily.pratt@acme.health
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: delay to multimodel support and request for pilot credit

Jonas — thanks for owning this. From a commercial process perspective: any concession over $10k or with legal/policy impact needs VP approval. I’ve sketched a quick approval note for execs and proposed the following terms:

- Offer: 1 month hosted-credit capped at $12,000 OR 20% off pilot usage for up to 4 weeks (customer choice).
- Conditions: applied only to pilot project (Deal ID ACME-2026-0914-TPILOT). No price precedent outside this pilot.
- Ops: RevOps to process credit memo and append an amendment to the SOW.

I’ll ping Marissa for signoff now. Laura — can you prepare the credit approval form and add the billing note? I’ll include a short exec summary for Marissa and VP Sales. Need decision by EOD tomorrow to preserve the pilot timeline.

— Karthik

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, emily.pratt@acme.health
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: delay to multimodel support and request for pilot credit

- Legal will want a sentence limiting the accommodation to the current pilot and confirming no SLA change.
- If we go with a percentage, we need the usage baseline (Emily: can you confirm expected pilot token/compute spend for the month?).

I’ll queue this in the approval workflow once Marissa signs the exec note. Attaching: credit-approval-form.docx.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
